program.section_heading: ACADEMIC PREPAREDNESS AND CAREER DEVELOPMENT CERTIFICATE OF COMPETENCY
outcomes: Demonstrate ability to write coherent expository essays and/or summary-responses at a level sufficient to transition to ENG 56 and/or ENG 1A.
Demonstrate ability to produce and comprehend advanced grammatical structures at a level sufficient to transition to 56 and/ or ENG 1A.
Demonstrate grammar, listening, speaking, and reading skills needed to clearly communicate and understand information and ideas in personal, academic, and vocational settings.
